name: Zhong An Intelligent Living Service Limited
summary: Zhong An Intelligent Living Service Limited, an investment holding company, provides integrated property management services in the Chinese Mainland. It operates through three segments: Property Management Services, Value-Added Services, and Community Value-Added Services. The Property Management Services segment provides residential and non-residential property management services to the property owners. The Value-Added Services segment offers cleaning, security and maintenance, sales office management, preliminary planning and design consultancy, and pre-delivery inspection services.
